summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report) enclosing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and related materials. Results reflect the July 1, 2026 formation of Arbex, a consumer-goods joint venture with Kimberly-Clark in which Suzano holds 51% and consolidates 100%; the company disclosed the segment separately, citing materiality, per an October 21, 2026 Notice to the Market. Adjusted EBITDA was R$5.7 billion, net debt/EBITDA 3.7x (3.4x pro forma), with no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics stated.
